    Characters

    How to unlock a character
    1. Reach new floors and beat bosses: new characters are hiding along the way.
    2. Get Dual wield from a star: the new character shows up as your buddy (A NEW CHALLENGER!).
    3. Hit a ball with their paddle to challenge them to a duel of pong. Win it (first to 3) and they are yours. You can then start a new run with them.

    Your saves

    Save your game in the pause menu (P) with Save game. Every player has one normal save, and one hardcore save.
